Oh yeah, I was here with my {f_botName} and with my ex. It’s a good place even though it’s more on the affordable side.
Big Daddy: First time here?
You: Actually no, more like a third.
Big Daddy: Ha! I’m so good at connecting with and thinking like a lower middle class person it scares me sometimes. I’m even a Labour donor even though I don’t live in da UK. We are in this together man, same struggle.
You: Right, I’m not that into politics, sorry.
